This trap turns all zombies on the lawn invisible. - Added the **"Seed Bank Randomiser Trap"** item. This trap randomises which seed packets are available in your seed bank. - Added the **"Ladder Trap"** item. This trap places a ladder on every active plant. - Added the **"Zombie Growth Serum Trap"** item. This trap causes zombies to grow, increasing their toughness. - Added the **"Paranoia Trap"** item. This trap plays the music associated with the Jack-in-the-Box zombie, and doesn't do anything else. Or does it? - Access new AP options via the title screen's options menu. You can adjust the following options, whenever you like: `death_link`, `ring_link`, `energy_link`, `seed_link`, `lawn_link`, `harder_zombie_spawns`, `imitater_behaviour` and `disable_storm_flashes`. - Corrected item groups. - Fixed an issue that was causing randomised plant stats to be applied in incorrect situations. - Wall-nut ricochets in "Adventure: Level 1-5" will now drop coins. - Made it clearer where Plants vs. Zombies-related information begins in the spoiler log.

entry.title: AEMinecraft v0.6.0
entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.6.0
Two new options for how death and your inventory work, an advancement screen that tells you where your items are, and a round of fixes to what the randomizer asks of you.
### New
**Hints on the advancement screen.** Every unlock tile (structures, mobs, Knowledge) now shows the item the way Archipelago names it, in Archipelago's colour for how important it is. Hold a tile for a moment to ask for its hint: the screen closes, reopens on the same tab once the answer arrives, and the tile says where the item is waiting — `Structure Unlock: Ancient City @ Sky's the Limit in Steve's world`. Hints made anywhere in the multiworld show up. For a progressive item, each level shows its own hint.
**See which advancements you actually earned.** When another player's release or collect sends one of your checks, that advancement used to turn gray like one you completed yourself. It now turns **blue**, so the gray tiles are the ones your world really earned, and the blue ones are still missing from your advancement goal. Tiles are now repainted in Minecraft's own text colours.
**Progressive Keep Inventory** — new option `keep_inventory` (with `keep_inventory_pool_size`). Instead of choosing between losing everything on death and the `keepInventory` gamerule, you can make it something you unlock over a run.
**Inventory Lock** — new option `inventory_lock`. Inventory slots start locked and open up as *Progressive Inventory Slot* items arrive.
- The **Biome Finder** no longer takes up an item: open it with its keybind or the compass button next to the recipe book. - A **chat filter** hides multiworld messages that have nothing to do with your slot. - Chat lines starting with `!` are sent to Archipelago as commands, e.g. `!hint`. - The advancement screen works with Better Advancements, Advancements Reloaded and Paginated Advancements.
### Fixed
- Locked baby zombies could reappear riding chickens in trial chambers after a reload. - With DeathLink on, every incoming death reset the timer phantoms need, so they could stop spawning entirely. - Sneaking with empty hands let you use something a Knowledge gate should have kept closed. - A locked structure is now rebuilt from the world when it unlocks, instead of keeping a copy of its blocks in your save. - Generating a seed with glitch logic could run out of memory (18 GB → about 1 GB).
### Logic
- Blocks that only exist once placed, and have no recipe, are no longer handed out free. - Ores count as a source for their item. A crafted block is not something to mine. - A recipe needs its crafting station, not just permission to use one. - Emeralds come from villagers; pottery sherds are brushed out, not looted. - Villagers need a village; Mooshrooms need their biome. - Filled buckets and villager trades are priced properly. - The Wandering Trader and BlazeandCave reward items only count as glitch-logic routes. - Killing several mobs with one arrow requires Piercing. - Trimming armor requires armor, a trim template and a smithing table.
### Upgrading
- The mod and the apworld are released together. Use them as a matched set. - Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer. - New YAML options `keep_inventory`, `keep_inventory_pool_size` and `inventory_lock`. Take them from the new template. Leaving them out gives you the defaults. - Unlock tiles only get their Archipelago colour on seeds generated with v0.6.0. - Regenerating a v0.5.1 seed with v0.6.0 gives a different placement. Finish existing seeds on the version they were generated with.

entry.title: Chrono Trigger Rando-Dalton Imperial v0.0.2
entry.content:
## Updated to the latest version of the RDI randomizer. - Options have been regenerated to pick up a few new/modified options - ctrando.zip package has been updated to the newest version of the rando
## Release notes copied from RDI: ### QoL, Bugfixes, and Logic Tweaks, This week's update is mainly fixes and QoL stuff to (partially) implement some recent suggestions. The QoL stuff is all about boss text matching the assigned bosses. When a boss name occurs in-game we want it to match the actual boss rando assignment. * Azala will call out the correct boss name in the Reptite Lair. * The Dragon Tank replacement will be properly named in text. The manual dropped by the prison supervisor will also be updated. The manuals are mostly meant to be helpful to describe boss behavior. I'm open to suggestions because these are a bit rough!
There are a few optional logic tweaks that were asked for. The main complaint with recent seeds was too many seeds funneled into Magus Ocean Palace for flight. * `force_early_flight = true/false` is actually a flag that's been around for a while, but it wasn't advertised. When set to `true` *and* `jets_of_time=true` it forces the jets to be logically available before the blackbird dungeon is available. * `magus_sequence_break_ocean_palace = true/false` controls whether logic believes Magus being able to enter ocean palace is in logic or a sequence break. The default (`false`) is how we've been playing previously. * `magus_logical_magus_castle = true/false` controls whether logic believes Magus is required to get to the back half of Magus's castle. The default (`false`) is how we've been playing previously. * The starter reward `proto_door` can be given so that the door to the portal is unlocked without having to do factory.
There are a few notable bugfixes. * Many issues with the gauntlet should be fixed now. These include skipped phases and lack of rewards copying for some bosses. * The R-Series "beast toss" should never softlock now. * It was possible to assign midbosses to boss spots, and that was creating some problems. This is no longer allowed. If your old tomls break, remove flea plus and super slash from boss_pool.

entry.title: AEMinecraft v0.6.1
entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.6.1
A hotfix release: generation no longer hangs with BlazeandCave's Advancements Pack.
### Fixed
**Generation froze at "Beginning output..." with BlazeandCave's Advancements Pack.** Seeds using BACAP together with the mob or structure locks could sit at "Beginning output..." for 15 minutes or more, and on machines with less memory could fail outright. These seeds now generate normally: the heaviest reported setup (BACAP, glitch logic, every lock and `challenge_sanity: all`) finishes in under a minute.
### Improved
**Generation is faster and uses far less memory.** The apworld stopped building millions of duplicate copies of the same logic. The reported seed went from about 9 GB of memory to just over 1 GB, and seeds without BACAP generate roughly twice as fast.
### Upgrading
- **Only the apworld changed.** The mod is identical to v0.6.0, so if you already installed the v0.6.0 mod you can keep it and just replace the apworld. - **Seeds generated with v0.6.0 are unaffected** and can be finished as they are. - Item placement is unchanged: the same YAML and seed produce the same world in v0.6.0 and v0.6.1. - No YAML changes are required.

entry.title: AEMinecraft v0.6.2
entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.6.2
A logic release. Many checks showed as reachable before the game, or the mod, would let you complete them. A few others were harder than they should have been.
### Fixed
**Checks that were in logic too early.** Each of these could show as reachable while something the game requires, or something the mod locks, was still missing:
- **Villager and Wandering Trader trades.** Checks about the Wandering Trader (Travelling Merchant, Shady Deals, Florist, Rebuilding the Oceans) now need the Wandering Trader, not just any villager. Trading for locked items (All chained up, Retro Future Knight) now needs the Knowledge and Material Handling to take them out of the trade. - **Tools and armor from trades, chests and mobs** now need their Material Handling tier, the same as the mod requires. A stone pickaxe bought from a toolsmith no longer counts with zero Material Handling. - **Checks about a mob** need that mob unlocked: - I'm in Lava With You, Death by Magic, Gas!, My eyes!, Spleaf - Arbalistic, It Spreads, What's Up, Doc?, Surge Protector - BACAP challenges such as Beef Moover, Overwarden, The World Is Ending and Why do I hear boss music? - **Charcoal and composters.** Renewable Energy needs the smelting recipe; breaking a campfire no longer counts. Knowledge: Crafter only lets you craft together with Knowledge: Crafting Table. - **Potion effects on mobs** are now required (Gas Bomb). - **Mob Kabob** asks for a spear instead of a trident.
**Checks that were wrongly locked or unpriced.**
- **Kilometre Walk** no longer waits for the Biomes tab. - **All the Items!, All the Blocks!, Pottery Exhibition, Tricky Treasures, sus** and a few others used to fall back to "reach the previous advancement". They now require what they actually need: - creeper-drop music discs - Trial Chamber pottery sherds - firework stars - suspicious sand and gravel, which drop when they fall onto a cobweb - **Levitation, Dolphin's Grace and Conduit Power** no longer require a brewing stand.
### Biome Finder
- **Items that only grow in rare biomes** need the Biome Finder, or a structure that contains them, when the Biome Finder is enabled. That covers cocoa beans, glow berries, melons, jungle and pale oak wood, moss, dripleaves, sculk and mycelium. - **Mobs that live in a rare biome** now show as possible-with-effort (yellow) without the Biome Finder, instead of out of logic, as long as the mob itself is unlocked.
### Upgrading
- **Only the apworld changed for players.** The mod gains a developer dump command but nothing that affects play, so the v0.6.1 mod jar keeps working. - **Seeds generated with v0.6.1 are unaffected** and can be finished as they are. - **Regenerating a v0.6.1 seed with v0.6.2 gives a different placement**, because the logic is stricter. - **No YAML changes are required.**

entry.title: GemCraft: Frostborn Wrath v0.6.2r2
entry.content:
A quality-of-life release: you can now chat and ask for hints without leaving the game, out-of-logic fields tell you what logic expects you to beat first, the Game Elements window shows what is in and out of logic at a glance, and a batch of logic and tooltip bugs are gone. Seeds generated with 0.0.6.2 keep working.
## What's new
### In-game chat and hints - The message log panel (backtick key) now has a text box. Type **!hint <item>** or plain chat straight from the game, no text client needed. - Incoming chat and server messages show up in the same panel.
### Knowing what to do next - Hovering an out-of-logic field now shows **"Beat N more fields first"**. When fewer than four fields are needed it names them, and lists any field token you are still missing. - The **Game Elements** window colours matching fields **green** when they are in logic and **red** when they are not. - The field tooltip now shows **Endurance XP** next to Journey XP, each with the XP multiplier that was recorded for that run.
### Balance and options - The default **difficulty** is now **Medium** instead of Hard. Existing YAMLs that set it explicitly are unaffected. - **Extra shadow cores per wave** are now boosted by **Seeker Sense**, exactly like normal core drops (up to double at max rank). - Talisman fragments now come in varied jigsaw shapes instead of one repeated pattern. - The option descriptions in the YAML template were reworded for clarity.
### Debug menu - New **Pouches** and **Keys** tabs so gem pouches and stash keys can be granted for testing. - A repeatable **+10000 shadow cores** button on the Cores tab.
## Bug fixes since 0.0.6.2
- With **per_tile_progressive** gem pouches and `non_local_items: Everything`, pouches could still be placed in your own world — fixed. - The field tooltip popped up through windows drawn over the map, such as the Debug or Game Elements panels — fixed. - Dragging the map with the mouse stopped working after fields were unlocked, while keyboard scrolling still worked — fixed. - A save that needed to reconnect was offered **"Play without randomizer"**. That choice is now only shown on a brand-new save — fixed. - The XP trait multiplier was not displayed correctly in the field tooltip — fixed. - Skills and traits toggled in the debug menu were reverted the next time the game saved — fixed. - The Game Elements grid scrolled underneath the icon strip at the top of the window — fixed. - Several achievements were reachable in logic far earlier than a player could realistically complete them. They now also require a suitable wizard level, wave count, or monster count. A few wrong requirements, such as the bolt-gem trap achievements, were corrected as well.
## Known limitations - The Game Elements colours refresh when the window is opened or a filter is toggled, not while an item arrives with the window open. - Wizard-level gating can still feel like one field unlocking the next in the early game. A revised progression model is being evaluated.
## Install See the [install guide](https://github.com/Levisaxos/Archipelago_GemcraftFrostbornWrath/blob/main/README.md).

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.14.0
entry.content: ## Changes Missions that change their own rules, a tracker your spectators can open, SigMod missions the launcher installs itself, and the Grappling Hook fix the last release left on nightly. Bots at 0.15.1. ### The run - **Mission modifiers.** A `mission_modifiers` option, off by default, gives every drawn mission its own rules: low or high gravity, robots plated against blast, fire or bullets, robots 15% faster or half size, robots that can crit, tanks carrying an invulnerable sentry, waves that refill the moment a robot dies, aim that wanders off the crosshair, ground with no grip, and mercenaries who take a quarter more damage. The seed chooses once per mission and keeps the combination, so a mission you return to plays the same twists again. One or two a mission by default, and `minimum_mission_modifiers` and `maximum_mission_modifiers` set the range. - **A tracker for spectators.** A web page anybody with the link can open: which missions are cleared, what has been checked, what the multiworld has unlocked, and the weapon buffs each class carries and at what level. Viewers need no room password, the page needs no server of its own, and a live tracker refreshes once a minute. The room has to have tracking enabled, and a seed made with an older apworld cannot show its starting inventory. - Test mode hands you the missions you picked. The missions you ticked into the pool are unlocked from the start, so `!mission` can switch to any of them straight away instead of only the one you start on. - A wave picker beside Play on the mission list. Pick a wave and the mission starts there, with the money the game gives for having won every wave before it. It opens on the wave your team got to, so the mission you left part way through is one click from where you left it. - The run remembers the highest wave you reached in every mission, not only the one you were on. Going to look at another mission no longer throws the first one's progress away. - The wave restore now waits for the game to agree before it says it worked. It used to announce the wave it had asked for, which is why a player could read "Restored: Quarry at wave 3 of 6" and be standing in wave one. If the jump never takes, the log says so and names the wave the game is actually on. ### Weapon buffs - Skins and decorated weapons draw from the gun they are a copy of. A buff rolled for the Holy Mackerel used to belong to the Holy Mackerel alone; it is a Bat buff now, and the same goes for the decorated versions of weapons you already own. The Self-Aware Beauty Mark counts as Jarate. - Weapons that are the same gun under different names share one pool. The Saxxy, the Conscientious Objector and the other all-class melees draw one "All-Class Melee" buff between them instead of one each, and the Bootlegger draws what Ali Baba's Wee Booties draws. Fewer duplicate rolls, and every roll lands on a weapon that can use it. - Your own explosions no longer bleed, ignite, milk or Jarate you. The hit effects were written where the game could read them on self-inflicted blast damage, so rocket jumping with a bleed rocket launcher bled its owner. ### The launcher - SigMod community missions install themselves. On Linux the launcher downloads SigMod, loads it, and the missions that need it come off their lock. The Docker image already carried it. On Windows they stay locked: SigMod has no Windows build, and porting it is its own project. - A seed made by a different apworld version says what to do about it. The refusal named two numbers and no action, and two people a week apart asked what they meant. It names the two ways out now: regenerate the seed with the apworld that shipped with this launcher, or run the launcher the seed was made for. - The Rewards toggles say what they switch. "Rewards" is "Grappling Hook", and the labels read "enabled" and "disabled" instead of "in the pool" and "include cash filler". - Joining from the launcher works when Steam's relay is in use. The relay address sometimes reached the launcher and sometimes only the game's own console log, which the launcher reads now. - Community missions hand their wave icons to joining players over the HTTP download. They showed on the machine running the server and nowhere else. ### Fixed - The Grappling Hook can be turned on. The launcher wrote every option the apworld takes except that one, so a run generated from its tf2.yaml never had the hook in it and hand-editing the file was the only way in. It is a row on the Rewards page now, under Server levers. - A held Grappling Hook shows on the Unlocks screen. The screen listed four kinds of unlock and the hook is a fifth, so it arrived, the plugin turned it on, and nothing said so. ### The bots The mod moves to 0.15.1. - A robot sent where the navigation mesh has no ground no longer takes the wave down with it. The list of walkable tiles around a point came back empty and was read as if it had entries. By kelly-cs. - The medic spends the break healing, so his über is full when the wave starts. The charge never built: every wave opened with it empty, and a mission got one über where it now gets seven. Measured on Decoy. - A released über keeps the beam on the player it started on, instead of drifting to whoever was nearest when the button went down. - The medic heals the biggest body, and only a player who calls for him jumps the queue. A quiet player standing in spawn used to hold the top of the list for a whole wave while the beam landed on whoever was nearby. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`.env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/.env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * fix(plugin): PLUGIN_VERSION says 1.13.0, like the apworld by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/58 * fix(launcher): the Grappling Hook can be turned on, and shows when it lands by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/59 * fix(bridge): a format version mismatch says what to do about it by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/60 * chore(beads): triage of Discord and the issue tracker since 1.12 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/61 * fix(launcher): make reward toggles intuitive by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/63 * fix(launcher): recover Steam relay address from console log by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/70 * feat(launcher): unlock selected missions in test mode by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/71 * Fix FastDL downloads for community wave icons by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/72 * feat(resume): a wave picker beside Play, and a mark kept per mission by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/66 * feat: add static visual campaign tracker by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/62 * chore(bots): pin v0.15.0 and drop the pin guard by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/76 * Fix buffs for decorated weapons and functional reskins by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/78 * Merge equivalent weapon buff pools by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/77 * Add SigMod community missions (for linux) by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/73 * Prevent hostile weapon buffs from triggering on self-damage by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/79 * Add per-mission gameplay modifiers by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/81 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.13.0...v1.14.0 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZTI3NmQwNjA0NGU3NDczODcyMzllMWM3N2NiY2Y0MGE6MTc4OTM3MzQxOA==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/Nzg4YWY0ZDFhNjkzYTRjMjRhYjExZmYzMGIzN2I5MmQ6MTc4OTM3MzQyMQ==/detection)

entry.title: Peggle Nights v2.0.0
entry.content:
This is a major feature release that also includes improvements and tweaks. It brings Peggle Nights to parity with the features of Peggle Deluxe 2.2.0.
**This release is NOT compatible with games generated on the previous version.**
- **Feature:** In-Game Level Locking - **Feature:** In-Game Master Locking - **Feature:** Progressive Fever Meter Threshold items have been completely replaced by level-specific Progressive Orange Pegs items, leading to more interesting and layered progression, as well as requiring a bit more skill for the early game phase - **Feature:** Purple Pegs are now unlockable by level - **Feature:** Each Peggle Master now has their own set of Progressive Green Pegs items, creating opportunities for suboptimal masters to now be optimal to play under certain circumstances - **Feature:** Added in / out of logic location counts under each level image in the Levels section of the custom client tab. Requires Universal Tracker to be installed - **Feature:** The section of the custom client tab showing information about the current level now lists what locations are accessible in / out of logic. Requires Universal Tracker to be installed - **Improvement:** To avoid the confusion that was present in 1.x.x around getting fever mode and no completion check, Level Clear location checks will now unlock after any fever mode completes. They will require half your starting ball items logically, but nothing prevents them from triggering - **Improvement:** To preserve the relevance of the 4th Progressive Orange Pegs item now that level completions have moved to the early-mid game, new Fever Meter Full location checks have been added - **Improvement:** Starting level count increased from 1 to 3 - **Improvement:** Starting ball count is now set through a custom code patch instead of directly setting the memory value, meaning that the Ball-O-Tron will now always display the correct amount of balls - **Improvement:** Getting the required quantity of Shadow Pegs is now all that's needed to access and clear the final level. No extra items to chase - **Improvement:** Added 3 extra copies of Progressive Starting Ball Increase and 1 extra copy of each Progressive Orange Pegs variant to allow for less restrictive progression and reaching the cap faster - **Improvement:** Slightly reworked logic, mainly around fever meter multipliers - **Improvement:** Custom client tab has been updated to reflect the new features - **Tweak:** Permanent Fever Meter Bonus useful items have been removed
_No new YAML options. Minimum level count is now 15 to make room for all the new items. You will need to remove Permanent Fever Meter Bonus from your useful item weights for existing YAMLs to be valid_
The implementation now has proper [documentation](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/peggle-nights/worlds/peggle_nights/docs/en_Peggle_Nights.md) and a [setup guide](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/peggle-nights/worlds/peggle_nights/docs/setup_en.md)

Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.14.0...v1.15.0 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/OWUzNTgwZGE1MGNkNjc4MTk5ZmRiOWY3MzM1NzcyMGU6MTc4OTQ1MTYxNQ==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZjRjMmJiNDZjNzllNzQ5ZWMxMmUyNDQ5ODNkNWYwZTA6MTc4OTQ1MTYxNg==/detection)
